name: Fed net-liquidity expansion turn + momentum — plumbing tailwind (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why net liquidity leads risk assets): net liquidity (Fed balance sheet minus the Treasury General Account) is the plumbing that funds risk-asset beta — when it expands, cash is released into the system and flows to the highest-beta assets, of which crypto is the extreme. The macro liquidity turn leads price because the plumbing moves first, then assets re-rate. We trigger on net_liquidity_usd crossing UP through a fitted level (an expansion regime turning ON) AND positive ret_Nd (crypto confirming its beta), and exit when net liquidity crosses back down (drain). DISCONFIRMER 1: if plain momentum without the liquidity gate matches the deflated Sharpe, liquidity adds nothing timeable. DISCONFIRMER 2 (PIT honesty): the keyless FRED series has a ~8-day publication lag and no vintage column, so we treat it as knowable only ~T+8 — if the edge depends on reacting FASTER than that lag, it is look-ahead and fake. Uses cross_up (a discrete regime turn) precisely because the level is non-stationary. tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: net_liquidity_usd crosses UP through a fitted level (Fed net liquidity expanding) while price momentum is positive.
